messages:
mira: hey all — quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A about promotions & comp. two quick things: are promotion effective dates always the start of the new quarter? and what's the policy for retroactive pay if the promotion is approved after the review window?

sara (people ops): great questions! short answers: effective date is usually the start of the payroll period following calibration, not strictly the quarter start. retro pay can be applied but there are limits (see below). :memo:

vp-people: adding that we try to avoid long backdating because it complicates budgeting and equity vesting. default is effective on the approved effective_date, and payroll handles a single retro payment up to 30 days. exceptions require exec sign-off.

alex (eng mgr): is there a firm deadline for managers to submit packet materials for calibration? i missed the slide during the all-hands.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Manager packet submission window for this cycle: 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC — 2026-04-10 17:00 UTC. Uploads after window go into next cycle.

sara (people ops): yes — manager packet upload closes 4/10 17:00 UTC. calibration meeting is 4/17. if you miss upload window, you can still raise a late case but it will need approval from VP+ and may not include retro pay.

jamal: how do spot bonuses vs promotions interact? someone on my team got a strong exec-level review but manager proposed a small spot bonus instead of a level up — is that typical?

vp-people: we allow spot bonuses for one-off extraordinary contributions. promotions are for sustained change in scope/impact. People Ops will flag borderline cases in calibration and recommend which lever (promo vs bonus) fits comp budget and hiring bar.

mira: thanks — what about appeals? if an IC disagrees with calibration outcome what's the process & timeline?

sara (people ops): appeals: 1) discuss with manager within 5 business days of notification. 2) if unresolved, submit appeal form within 10 business days. 3) appeals reviewed by an appeals panel (3 leaders) within 15 business days. outcomes: uphold, partial, or full. final decisions communicated via manager.

alex (eng mgr): can we see anonymized calibration notes or benchmarks to coach folks?

people-ops-bot: People Ops note: anonymized calibration guidance will be published in Confluence under /people-ops/calibration-guides by 2026-04-20.

jamal: last one from me — comp bands: any movement this cycle? engineers asking if bands shift will we get auto adjustments?

vp-people: comp bands are reviewed annually. if bands are restructured we do a mapping exercise and apply adjustments where people fall below new minima. not automatic for everyone; there is a prioritization for impacted roles and budget.

mira: super helpful. can sara or someone post a short FAQ recap + the timeline so we can reference it in 1:1s? :raising_hand:

sara (people ops): will do — I'll drop a one-pager + FAQ in #people-ops today and ping managers. expect: timeline, retro-pay policy, upload window, appeals link, and contact for exceptions. :white_check_mark:

vp-people: thanks everyone — we want this to be transparent. if there are specific edge cases (equity cliff concerns, external offers, relocation), DM me or file an exceptions ticket and we'll triage. :handshake:
